messages:
Alice Sales: FYI — prospective POC (FortisBank) wants an on‑prem air‑gapped trial. Questions: packaging size, upgrade cadence expectations, delta vs full installs, and pricing for reserved capacity vs BYO infra. Can eng + sec confirm feasibility? cc @Cara SE @Ben Eng

Ben Eng: We can support air‑gapped POCs. Key points: delta bundles supported, signed bundles only, offline activation tokens. For upgrades we recommend quarterly regular cadence + monthly emergency patches. Full reinstalls only if major kernel/drivers change.

Cara SE: For the POC we can produce a trimmed minibundle (weights quantized) to shrink size. Typical minibundle ~2–4GB depending on model. We can also provide a 'delta apply' flow so you only ship ~100–300MB diffs for routine updates.

Dinesh Sec: On security: customer will need signed SBOMs and bundle signing process (we can support HSM/KMS signing workflow). Also need to confirm FIPS/HSM requirements and their cipher policy. Some large banks insist on annual upgrades only — may block monthly cadence.

Eve IT: Their security ops asked: can we do staged rollouts + guaranteed ability to rollback without outbound connectivity? They also pushed back on any agent that phones home.

Ben Eng: Staged rollouts are supported offline — you pre‑stage bundles to a holdback group, then flip. Rollback works but requires the previous bundle pre‑staged locally (we don't fetch it during rollback). No heartbeat required for basic runtime; telemetry optional and blocked in sealed mode. Maintenance windows: plan for 2–4 hours for a full bundle swap on production GPU nodes.

Alice Sales: Pricing/Q: can we offer a discounted 12‑month reserved commit with private deployment + packaging fee? Customer asked about one‑time packaging vs per‑release fees.

Cara SE: Standard approach: one‑time packaging & signing setup fee + monthly private license. For a 12‑mo reserved commitment we typically waive the packaging fee or credit it. We should confirm with finance for exact figures.

Eve IT: They also want 24/7 support for the POC week and a runbook before the trial begins. Can we commit?

Ben Eng: For POC we can provide prioritized on‑call and a dedicated eng contact during the trial week as an add‑on. For production private installs we offer tiered SLAs; 24/7 is an enterprise add‑on.

deploy-bot: Last air‑gapped bundle we shipped: version v1.14.2, full image 3.8GB, delta patch 128MB (signed).

Dinesh Sec: Also need to know if customer requires supply chain attestations, SBOM level, and whether their change control requires pre‑approval of each patch. That affects cadence strongly.

Cara SE: I'll assemble a POC runbook draft: preflight checks (GPU drivers, kernel, SELinux/AppArmor stance), bundle staging steps, manifest validation, rollback test, required maintenance window, key exchange steps for signing.

Alice Sales: Thanks — I'll loop in finance & legal, and schedule a tech deep‑dive Wed 10am PT. Eve — can you confirm their availability + send over their security questionnaire before then?

Eve IT: Acknowledged. I'll collect availability and the sec questionnaire and share by EOD Monday.
